messages:
sam: Heads-up — Deploybot scheduled a phased v2 rollout to US-west starting in ~20m. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m checks. Can folks confirm the pinlist and rollback criteria?

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout created id=rb-65498 policy=phased(10,50,100) canary_duration=20m probes=probe-998

anya: Release notes draft is up: "v2: opt-in API behavior; default remains compatible with v1 header negotiation. See notes and migration tips." Link posted in chat.

leo: Quick callout — acme-inc still sends header as "Version" capitalized; their SDK will mis-route. Recommend tenant pin to v1 for 24h.

maria: Done — added acme-inc to pinlist in deploybot: tenant:acme-inc -> force:v1 for 24h.

sam: Operator handoff plan: leo will watch first stage, then hand to ops-oncall. Rollback triggers: 
- request error-rate > 1% sustained (5m)
- or 5xx spike >50% over baseline (5m)
If triggered, ops-oncall pauses and we rollback rb-65498.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll wire up alerts and the runbook. Command to rollback? /deploy rollback rb-65498 (confirm?)

sam: yes that's the command. Also add a pause window command so deploybot doesn't auto-progress while we're evaluating.

anya: Docs request: short SDK note about header negotiation + migration tips. @maria can you ping docs to publish the blurb?

maria: Pinged #docs with the snippet and a PR link. ETA ~2h for publish.

leo: Suggest a tiny probe on streaming path: route 1% of traffic through streaming-ex path. If median latency >500ms for 10m, pause rollout. That catches cold-start regressions.

sam: Good idea. deploy-bot, can you add that probe to the rollout?

 deploy-bot: Deploybot: added probe id=probe-998 target=streaming-ex pct=1 trigger=median_latency>500ms(10m) action=pause

ops-oncall: Quick question — are we permitting fallback to quantized variants if capacity becomes constrained during rollout? Need to know for runbook.

sam: Permitted for latency-critical text-gen routes only; not permitted for embeddings or rerankers. Rollout config includes fallback: allowed=text-gen; disallowed=embeddings,rerank.

anya: Final check: release note link https://redwood.internal/release/v2-rollout-65498 — can everyone sanity-check and thumbs-up?

leo: Looks good from infra side. I'll stay on the first 40m and watch the canary metrics. :thumbsup:

maria: All set from docs/comms side.

sam: Thanks everyone. Starting the deploy now; I’ll post updates. If anyone sees anomalies, call out in this thread and ops-oncall will pause.

ops-oncall: Oncall ready. Will escalate immediately if alert fires.

sam: Deploy started — rb-65498 progressing to 10%. Will update at 10m and on probe events.
